author_note: Written blind from the CSVs and the cpr checker only; the author did not read the system's code, evals, docs or tests.

cases.question: rfi 11 - who has the ball and what is it holding up?
cases.reference: RFI-011 (Structural support for relocated rooftop unit) is open with the Structural engineer holding the ball. It was needed by 2026-08-31 because it holds up the crane booking; it references A-211 and spec 09 21 16 and is flagged cost impact possible, schedule impact yes.
cases.source: rfis.csv RFI-011

cases.question: whats the lead time on the RTU submittal and when do we need it on site
cases.reference: The rooftop unit submittal is S-007 (spec 23 74 13, product data, Sample Mechanical). Its lead time is 56 days and it is required on site 2026-11-02; it is marked approved.
cases.source: submittals.csv S-007 rev 0

cases.question: ce5 - how much and how many days, and where does it stand?
cases.reference: CE-005, Asbestos-containing mastic under carpet, is an unforeseen condition estimated at $22,300.00 and 6 days. Its status is priced; notice was given 2026-08-27, before the 2026-09-09 deadline.
cases.source: change_events.csv CE-005

cases.question: was there an inspection on sep 10? how did it go
cases.reference: Yes. The 2026-09-10 daily report records an above-ceiling inspection in the reading room, which passed. That day it also rained from 10:00 and roofing stood down.
cases.source: daily_reports.csv 2026-09-10

cases.question: did we run into any hazardous materials on this job?
cases.reference: Yes: change event CE-005 records asbestos-containing mastic under the carpet, an unforeseen condition dated 2026-08-26, estimated at $22,300.00 and 6 days and currently priced.
cases.source: change_events.csv CE-005

cases.question: did anyone ever decide what colour the old radiators get painted?
cases.reference: No decision is recorded. RFI-009 (Paint colour for existing radiators, created 2026-08-05) is still open with the Architect and has no answer; it also has no date needed recorded.
cases.source: rfis.csv RFI-009; checker WARNING Q07 RFI-009 has no date needed

cases.question: what safety talks have the crews had
cases.reference: The only safety notes are toolbox talks on ladders, held seven times: 2026-08-03, 08-10, 08-17, 08-24, 08-31, 09-07 and 09-14. No other safety entries are recorded.
cases.source: daily_reports.csv safety_notes

cases.question: any open questions about the accessible entry?
cases.reference: RFI-015, Threshold detail at accessible entrance (ref S-115), is open with the Architect. It was needed by 2026-09-28 for entrance paving, so it is 41 days overdue as of 2026-11-08.
cases.source: rfis.csv RFI-015; checker most overdue RFI-015 (41 days)

cases.question: give me the full story on the sprinkler main vs duct clash, rfi, delays, money, all of it
cases.reference: RFI-013 (existing sprinkler main in conflict with new duct, needed 2026-09-08 for level 1 duct installation) is still open with nobody holding the ball, 61 days overdue. Daily reports on 09-09, 09-11, 09-14, 09-15, 09-16 and 09-17 record 'Waiting on RFI-013 at corridor duct'. Change event CE-007 (delay, 2026-09-09) is open at $0.00 and 3 days, and no notice is recorded although notice was due 2026-09-23.
cases.source: rfis.csv RFI-013; change_events.csv CE-007; daily_reports.csv 2026-09-09..09-17; checker WARNING Q06 RFI-013, WARNING Q08 CE-007, most overdue RFI-013 (61 days)

cases.question: where are we on the rooftop unit relocation? the rfi, the support steel and the unit itself
cases.reference: RFI-011 on structural support is open with the Structural engineer, 69 days past its 2026-08-31 need date (crane booking). CE-004, Relocated rooftop unit support steel, is open at $18,500.00 and 5 days with no notice recorded although notice was due 2026-09-03. The unit submittal S-007 is marked approved (56-day lead, needed on site 2026-11-02) but has no returned date.
cases.source: rfis.csv RFI-011; change_events.csv CE-004; submittals.csv S-007; checker WARNING Q08 CE-004, ERROR Q05 S-007, most overdue RFI-011 (69 days)

cases.question: what happened with the floor leveling in the stacks? did it cost us
cases.reference: RFI-004 asked about leveling compound depth at the stacks area and was answered 2026-07-28 with cost impact possible. That led to CE-003, Extra floor leveling at stacks area, estimated at $7,920.00 and 1 day, status submitted. Notice was given 2026-08-14, after the 2026-08-11 required date, which the checker says to take to whoever manages the contract.
cases.source: rfis.csv RFI-004; change_events.csv CE-003; checker WARNING Q08 CE-003

cases.question: circ desk - whats the overall status, finish question, shop drawings, any extras?
cases.reference: RFI-012 on the casework finish is open with the Architect, needed 2026-09-21 for millwork shop drawings (48 days overdue). Submittal S-005, Circulation desk casework, has not been submitted (ball with Sample Millwork; 49-day lead, needed on site 2026-10-19) and is the worst procurement risk at 69 days. The owner's upgraded finish, CE-006 at $9,100.00, was rejected.
cases.source: rfis.csv RFI-012; submittals.csv S-005; change_events.csv CE-006; checker procurement at risk S-005 (69 days), most overdue RFI-012 (48 days)

cases.question: which rfis are overdue today and whos sitting on each one
cases.reference: As of 2026-11-08 five RFIs are overdue: RFI-010 (75 days, Architect), RFI-011 (69 days, Structural engineer), RFI-013 (61 days, nobody holding the ball), RFI-012 (48 days, Architect) and RFI-015 (41 days, Architect). RFI-009 is also open with the Architect but has no date needed, so it cannot be called overdue.
cases.source: checker RFIs overdue 5, most overdue line, open by ball in court; rfis.csv

cases.question: which submittals are gonna bite us on procurement?
cases.reference: Four submittals are past the latest approval date that their lead time allows: S-005 circulation desk casework (69 days, not submitted), S-004 rev 1 resilient tile flooring (62 days, in review), S-008 interior lighting fixtures (55 days, in review) and S-010 interior paint colours (39 days, in review).
cases.source: checker procurement at risk line and WARNING Q11 lines for S-004, S-005, S-008, S-010

cases.question: how many punch items r past due
cases.reference: 14 punch items are past due: all were due 2026-09-15 and are still open (10) or ready for review (4), so they are 54 days late as of 2026-11-08. By trade: Painting 3, Electric 3, Mechanical 3, Flooring 3, Drywall 2.
cases.source: checker Punch list open 14, ready for review 4, overdue 14, open by responsible party; punch_items.csv

cases.question: total open exposure on change events, dollars and days?
cases.reference: Open exposure is $48,720.00 and 15 days, from the four events not yet approved or rejected: CE-003 ($7,920, 1 day, submitted), CE-004 ($18,500, 5 days, open), CE-005 ($22,300, 6 days, priced) and CE-007 ($0, 3 days, open).
cases.source: checker Change events open exposure cost 48720.00, open exposure days 15; change_events.csv

cases.question: on average how many guys were on site, and what was the busiest day
cases.reference: Across the 32 daily reports the average manpower is 23.2 (741 worker-days). The peak was 28 workers, reached on 2026-08-05, 2026-08-20 and 2026-09-08.
cases.source: checker Daily reports average manpower 23.2; daily_reports.csv manpower_total

cases.question: how many days did weather knock out roof work
cases.reference: Three days: 2026-08-13, 2026-08-27 and 2026-09-10, each recording rain from 10:00 with roofing stood down. All other reports are dry.
cases.source: daily_reports.csv weather and delays

cases.question: what period do the daily reports cover? any gaps?
cases.reference: There are 32 daily reports from 2026-08-03 to 2026-09-17. Seven working days have no report: 2026-08-21, 2026-09-04, 2026-09-18 and 2026-09-21 to 2026-09-24.
cases.source: checker Daily reports reports 32, first, last, working days missing 7, WARNING Q09 lines

cases.question: when did we get the answer back on rfi-14?
cases.reference: RFI-014 (extent of wall patching at removed shelving) is marked answered with 'Response attached.', but no answered date is recorded, so the date cannot be given. It was created 2026-09-08 and needed by 2026-09-15.
cases.source: rfis.csv RFI-014; checker ERROR Q05 RFI-014 is answered but has no answered date

cases.question: who signed off pl-4 as fixed?
cases.reference: PL-004 (Room 108, base cove loose, Sample Flooring) is closed with a closed date of 2026-09-10, but the verified_by field is blank, so nobody is recorded as having checked the fix.
cases.source: punch_items.csv PL-004; checker closed without verifier 2

cases.question: what's the CO number for the extra data outlets the owner asked for
cases.reference: That is CE-002, Owner-requested additional data outlets, approved at $12,640.00 and 2 days, but no change order number is recorded for it.
cases.source: change_events.csv CE-002; checker WARNING Q10 CE-002 is approved but has no change order number

cases.question: misc metals shop dwgs - how many times did we have to send them and whats the final status
cases.reference: S-001 (spec 05 50 00, Sample Metals) went in twice. Rev 0, submitted 2026-07-10, came back 2026-07-22 revise and resubmit; rev 1, submitted 2026-07-29, came back 2026-08-10 approved as noted, which is the current status.
cases.source: submittals.csv S-001 rev 0 and rev 1

cases.question: is the resilient flooring sample approved yet? we need to order
cases.reference: No. S-004 rev 0 came back revise and resubmit on 2026-08-20; rev 1 was submitted 2026-08-27 and is still in review with the Architect, whose review was due 2026-09-10. With a 35-day lead and a 2026-10-12 on-site date, approval was due 2026-09-07, so it is 62 days behind.
cases.source: submittals.csv S-004 rev 0 and rev 1; checker WARNING Q11 S-004 rev 1

cases.question: which change events trace back to an rfi?
cases.reference: Four: CE-001 from RFI-003 (abandoned conduit, approved as CO-001), CE-003 from RFI-004 (floor leveling), CE-004 from RFI-011 (rooftop unit support steel) and CE-007 from RFI-013 (sprinkler main delay). The checker also notes RFI-008 has cost and schedule impact but no change event refers to it.
cases.source: change_events.csv related_rfi; checker WARNING Q12 RFI-008

cases.question: pl-14 is in rm 104 right? what else is on the punch list in that room
cases.reference: Yes, PL-014 (base cove loose, Sample Flooring) is in Room 104 and is ready for review. The other Room 104 items are PL-002 missing cover plate (Sample Electric, closed), PL-008 diffuser not aligned (Sample Mechanical, closed) and PL-020 touch up paint at door frame (Sample Drywall, open).
cases.source: punch_items.csv location Room 104

cases.question: since the door hardware schedule got rejected, when is the resubmittal due?
cases.reference: The premise is wrong: S-002, Door hardware schedule (spec 08 71 00), was approved on 2026-07-30 at rev 0, so no resubmittal is needed. It has a 42-day lead and is required on site 2026-10-05.
cases.source: submittals.csv S-002 rev 0

cases.question: what did the inspector flag when the above ceiling inspection in the stacks failed?
cases.reference: No failed inspection is recorded. The only inspection in the daily reports is the above-ceiling inspection in the reading room on 2026-09-10, and it passed.
cases.source: daily_reports.csv inspections column (only 2026-09-10)

cases.question: whats the electrical sub foreman's name and cell number
cases.reference: The records do not hold contact details. They only name the electrical trade as Sample Electric, with no foreman name or phone number.
cases.source: all five CSVs; no contact fields in schema/fields.csv

cases.question: what's the original contract value for the library job and how much have we billed so far?
cases.reference: Neither the contract value nor billing appears in these records. The logs only hold change event estimates (for example approved CE-001 at $4,850.00 and CE-002 at $12,640.00), not the contract sum or invoices.
cases.source: all five CSVs; schema/fields.csv
